title: A nested deploy declared in the authorization tree is recorded without meta showing that it happened
severity_basis: A declared but unexecuted deploy produced a contract record. Issue #746 describes it and is still open; the fix landed as 80121f3a, one of the rebased commits of PR #739, without closing the issue. The linter fires at the pre-fix commit and is silent after (make lint-before-after).

entries.observed: XDR303: participant builder ProcessOperation never reads ledger meta (fee changes, operation changes or events), and no function of this package that reads meta calls it; participants come from meta, the envelope only labels causes

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from report row lint:github.com/stellar/wallet-backend@9538b3ca:XDR303:internal/indexer/processors/contract_deploy.go:ContractDeployProcessor.ProcessOperation.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline.
